en.name: Clement IV
en.summary: A pope, formerly a married layman and judge, whose backing of Charles of Anjou's conquest of Sicily ended Hohenstaufen rule in Italy.
en.body: Clement IV, who had been a lawyer and married father before entering the clergy after his wife's death, confirmed and supported Charles of Anjou's campaign against Manfred, which culminated in Manfred's defeat and death at the Battle of Benevento in 1266. The subsequent execution of the teenage Hohenstaufen claimant Conradin after his failed invasion effectively ended the dynasty's presence in Italy, cementing Angevin power in the south for generations.
